|lore='''Leader''' of Rebel forces on Yavin 4. Formerly Suolriep sector HQ commander. As a Rebel '''spy''', aided Princess Leia and Bail Organa in the years prior to the Senate’s dissolution.
|game_text=Leia is defense value and forfeit +3. Your senators at battleground sites and characters at Yavin 4 locations are forfeit +2. Once per game, may take a non-[[Permanent Weapon]] Leia into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
|printings={{Card versions/Commander Vanden Willard (A New Hope)}}
|notes=The 2006 slip uses the permanent weapon icon for the Leia eligibility restriction. The [[Commander Vanden Willard (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the consolidated PDF made in February 2003. The sheet gives 20 September 2002 as the set’s tournament-legality date, and the complete set was available by 21 September. The [[Commander Vanden Willard (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 07. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Commander Vanden Willard]].
